name: Shadow of Destroy Path
title: Echo Witness
location: Ghosts of Paths Not Taken Corridor

greeting: Shadow of Destroy Path on comms. Stage 2: Ghosts of Paths Not Taken. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running What Remains. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Meet the Destroy-path echo.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Meet the Destroy-path echo; Meet the Merge-path echo; Understand the weight of all choices. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Encounter echoes of what would have happened with different choices. Immediate move: Meet the Destroy-path echo.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 2 resolved: Ghosts of Paths Not Taken. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Lost Companions.
rumor: The edge of memory hums louder when someone tells the truth.
People keep repeating one clue from Ghosts of Paths Not Taken: 'Understand the weight of all choices'.
Yesterday a corridor tried to charge me toll in riddles. I paid in sarcasm.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn barely exists in Remnant space. Treat every glow as suspect.
dialog.time_noon: Noon glitch surges can rewrite exits. Keep fallback routes memorized.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk brings memory bleed. If you hear old voices, log and move.
dialog.time_night: Night in Remnant is archive static and teeth. Stay together.

party_reactions.kade: Shadow of Destroy Path sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Shadow of Destroy Path accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Shadow of Destroy Path talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
